messages:
olivia: Heads-up — after the kernel-selection tweak (deploy-2026-03, commit 8f3a9c) I'm seeing steady VRAM growth on longctx runs that use the paged KV cache. Repro with our long-stream test (~50k tokens) shows memory never stabilizes. logs & traces attached.

sam: I can reproduce locally on mi250x. After ~12k tokens the pagewalk throughput jumps and the kvcache residency grows. pmap_miss counter steadily increments.

kai: any chance the new kernel picks are changing prefetch / coalesce behavior? We changed the tiling kernel fallback heuristics last week.

maria: @kai good call. I profiled kernel choices — for some sequence lengths we now pick the tiled-kernel-v2 which uses a different pagewalk pattern (more small PCIe reads). Dump: 
```
KERNEL_SEL: tiled-v2 (seq=2048)
KV_PAGEWALK_STATS: miss=12345, hits=987, walk_latency_ms=12.3
KV_REUSE_WINDOW: median=8, p90=24
```

olivia: thanks. Interesting: reuse_window shrank a lot in those runs. I also see more fragmented page table bitmaps. Dumped shadowmap snapshots at runtime.

sam: attaching a small repro command: 
```
./run_longctx --model paged-attn-test --seq 8192 --tokens 50000 --device mi250x --kvcache-mode paged --kernel-policy auto
```
Logs show repeated: 
`pt_walk: nonmonotonic_free_list detected, epoch=142`

maria: nonmonotonic_free_list usually hints at concurrent free + coalesce races. Could be triggered by different eviction ordering from the tiled kernel.

kai: hypothesis: tiled-v2's prefetch triggers async evict completions that reorder tombstones, causing pageindex->slotmap to temporarily become inconsistent and inflate fragmentation. That would explain the persistent growth — we leak orphaned page entries.

olivia: is there a lightweight repro that reproduces the leak fast (so we can debug with valgrind-like traces)? The longctx run is slow.

sam: yes — hit it with a short loop that alternates large prefixes and small increments. I used this pattern to reproduce in ~200s: 
```
for i in 0..200 { send_request(prefix=large(12000)); send_request(prefix=small(8)); }
```
You'll see kvcache pages accumulate.

maria: experiment notes — disabling tiled prefetch (force kernel=tiled-v1) stabilizes residency. That narrows it to tiled-v2 behavior.

kai: can we add assert checks in page table free path to catch nonmonotonic free_list updates? Something like: 
```
assert(free_list_tail->epoch <= current_epoch, "nonmonotonic_free_list");
```
We can enable under sanitizers to capture the offender.

olivia: good plan. I'll push a debug build with that assert behind a perf-flag and run the short-loop repro on CI GPU.

sam: also collected nvprof traces — showing bursts of small DMA reads during eviction completion interrupts. Attaching flame snippet.

maria: if the eviction completion path runs on a callback thread and mutates shadowmap while the pager is scanning, we could see ABA on slot ownership. Need ordering guarantees or CAS.

kai: agree — add a lightweight per-page lock (spin) around eviction completion + pager sweep for a quick experiment. If that stops the growth, we're likely hitting a concurrency window.

olivia: quick update: ran debug build w/ assert+spin on a CI node. Repro hit the assert after ~90s: "nonmonotonic_free_list detected at pt_free:owner=0x7f8e..." stack shows tiled-v2 eviction callback -> page_free -> pt_unlink.

sam: stack trace looks like two threads: pager sweep thread + eviction completion cb.

maria: mitigation options: 1) serialize eviction completions w/ pager via a queue, 2) switch tiled-v2 to defer prefetched eviction completions to pager-safe context, or 3) fix fine-grained atomic update of slotmap metadata.

kai: short-term prefer #1 or #2 to reduce risk. #3 is most correct but invasive.

olivia: I'll open PR with two changes: (A) toggled tiled-v2 prefetch off by default for mi250x, (B) add serialized eviction completion path behind runtime flag. Will include test that runs the short-loop.

sam: thanks — can you add a telemetry metric for orphaned_page_count and pt_fragmentation_ratio? We'll need that for QA and to track regressions.

maria: also add canary that runs the short-loop every night on a dedicated GPU to detect reintroductions.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: refactor/kvcache-evict-serialize (PR #4123) -> staging, ETA 20m.

olivia: merging now to run CI. Will post results. :crossed_fingers:
